economy.summary: Her campaign platform calls for raising the minimum wage, addressing budget shortfalls at PennDOT and DEP, and investing in renewable energy to create new jobs.
economy.short: Calls for raising minimum wage, investing in renewable energy for jobs.

abortion.summary: Her campaign platform says she will continue to protect the right to choose and will not let Republican-led restrictions on that right pass in Pennsylvania.
abortion.short: Says she will protect the right to choose.

education.summary: Her campaign platform says she will continue to fight for a sustainable, fair school funding formula to ensure equitable funding for schools.
education.short: Supports a sustainable, fair school funding formula for equitable funding.

healthcare.summary: Her campaign platform says Pennsylvania needs to expand Medicaid and Medicare toward insuring 100% of citizens, stating that healthcare is a right.
healthcare.short: Supports expanding Medicaid and Medicare toward universal coverage.

energy.summary: Her campaign platform supports investing in renewable energy and says she will work for climate-change legislation and oversight based on facts and science.
energy.short: Supports renewable energy and science-based climate legislation.

guns.summary: Her campaign platform says background check laws should be strengthened so that only law-abiding individuals have access to firearms.
guns.short: Supports strengthening background check laws on firearm access.
